label: Set-up necessitation: with the same set-up, the giver gives the same beings
definition: SetupNecessitatedAt F A w y: for every world v accessible from w at which y exists and SetupSameIn A y w v, GivingSameIn F y w v (y gives being to exactly the same beings at v as at w).
note: Analyst definition, attribution deferred (docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md). The sense of 'necessitating source' fixed for the will step (#1926 phase 3): a deterministic power, whose giving is fixed by its set-up. Example: fire heating the same fuel under the same conditions. Non-examples: a CHANCE_3 propensity; a willed two-way giving. With an invariant set-up it is exactly giving the same beings at every accessible world where the giver exists, and a FixedGiver (DEF 7bc1d667) existing at w is set-up necessitated (Model.Laws 14); with an invariant set-up, factive giving and a necessary giver it makes every effect at w necessary (Model.Laws 8; without invariance a giver whose set-up varies is vacuously set-up necessitated: the counterpart of #555 rigid_core with StrictEfficacy, DEF 01b44013, and of #1897 law 3). With excluded middle, VG is set-up necessitation of every being at w (law 9). Its relation to the other senses of a necessitating source (strict efficacy of one act, DEF 01b44013; fixed giving; a necessitating reason, DEF 3055e6f1) is recorded in the NECESSITATE disambiguation and docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md, section 2.
